Answer: D
Reason: The endoscopic image shows a white foreign body obstructing a bronchial orifice, which corresponds to the right upper lobe bronchus in typical clinical case presentations of this nature; obstruction here leads to resorption atelectasis of the right upper lobe. Options suggesting left-sided pathology or tracheal location are inconsistent with the focal endobronchial view and standard right-sided predominance of such aspirations.
